From cleaning to ingredient shopping, preparation, and service, Christian follows chef Minh Phat Tu through a day managing his three restaurants.
Celebrating lemons. Accompanied by comedian Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a two-lemon meringue tart. Discovery of the day: Sansho berry. Presentation: Annick Jeanmairet.
The chef prepares a strawberry and cream cake that will delight anyone intolerant to gluten, without sacrificing indulgence.

"Dans cette partie de la Bresse située en Saône-et-Loire, Jean-Thomas Vuillard est pisciculteur ; Alexandre Cauchy, producteur de piment et maraîcher. programmes.d: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.
Au menu : la recette de la cheffe Marie Robert, rencontre avec un chocolatier fan de musique metal, dégustation d'un petit-déjeuner typiquement parisien, le dessert de Christophe Loeffel.

Casoncellis, 100% pork ravioli.Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a recipe for casoncellis, original crescent-shaped ravioli. Discovery of the day: the torrée, a Neuchâtel tradition.
Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

"Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programmes.t: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programmes.d: A Michelin-starred chef at the Rouge restaurant in Nîmes, Georgiana Viou returns to Marseille, where it all began for the chef. The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programmes.t: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programmes.d: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.
Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

"Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."
Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programmes.t: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programmes.d: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programmes.t: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programmes.d: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.
The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

"Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."
You have accidently drowned your noodles in soya sauce? Luckily, the three presenters are there to transform this mistake into an excellent accompaniment.
How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

"Rencontre avec Nicolas Bucher, éleveur de vache montbéliarde, et avec Nathalie Vernerey, cheffe de culture maraîchère aux Jardins d'idées. Le phytomanagement au Living Lab de Vieux-Charmont, avec Michel Chalot, professeur d'université et biologiste en environnement. « Pas si bêtes », avec Thibaut Seguin, animateur à La Damassine."

programmes.d: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programmes.d: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.
For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

A stage that ends in the Michelin-starred restaurant Don Alfonso 1890, around a dish of scorpion fish pasta.

programmes.d: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

Mushrooms and eggs. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares baked eggs with mushrooms and a spring frittata (Italian egg-based dish), with lots of greens (dandelion, arugula, spinach). Discovery of the day: artisanal mate, a drink that is all the rage.
To entertain simply and stylishly, the chef offers a menu featuring haddock poached in coconut milk and a crunchy salad.

Vincent Labergère est producteur de Sauternes ; Émilie et Michel Dudon sont éleveurs de volailles en plein air. En compagnie d'Adrien Billotte et Pierre Cante, tout savoir sur le bombage et la cartographie, pour lutter contre la flavescence dorée.

programmes.d: For the first time, Charles-Antoine chairs a pie contest in Abercorn, with a special guest. Before that, he installs reclaimed planters and receives the beehives from his friend Anicet.

April Fools fish. Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a fish ceviche with leche de tigre, a more complex mixture than lime juice, followed by fish paupiettes wrapped in chard leaves, steamed. Discovery of the day: chard táchon.
Ricardo joins Isabelle to celebrate bread in all its forms: a savory garlic version, perfect for sharing, and a brioche variation with chocolate, cranberries, and ginger.

Romain Boulet est éleveur de moutons boulonnais ; Loïc Cheuva est directeur de l'association Atelier Cré'Actif sur la cressonnière d'Enquin-sur-Baillons. Sortie nature dans les marais, avec la guide nature Caroline Géneau. Découverte du cap Blanc-Nez, avec Martha Coquet, animatrice d'Eden62.

The chef draws inspiration from classic desserts and presents a simplified version of the Black Forest cake. Perfect for impressing guests on special occasions.

Rencontre avec le viticulteur Pierre Dubreuil et la productrice de plantes aromatiques Véronique Briday. Découverte de la microfaune souterraine avec les spéléologues Josiane et Bernard Lips. Animation scolaire avec Marion Crampette, de l'association du réseau des Rivières Sauvages.

programmes.d: The aquaponics system is up and running at the Earthship, while piles are installed to reinforce the extension. Charles-Antoine visits his family in Mirabel. He also drops by to see his favourite market gardener, Jean-Pierre Bertrand.
Isabelle creates a salmon tart inspired by bagels and deconstructs the famous lemon tart into bars.

Long live legumes. On the menu: lentils papet vaudois style and crispy chickpeas for the aperitif. Discovery of the day: Geneva longeole cooked on the plancha. Annick Jeanmairet is once again assisted by comedian Brigitte Rosset.

Valentin Fleytoux et Rodolphe Dieudonné sont producteurs fermiers de cancoillotte ; Camille Ponnelle et Xavier Mariot sont agriculteurs et produisent des huiles. Réhabilitation de la rivière La Linotte avec Guillaume Blondel-Gaborieau, ingénieur et maire de Loulans-Verchamp. Cueillette sauvage et réintroduction d'essences locales avec Adrien Léturgie, de l'association FNE 70.

programmes.d: It is time to put the finishing touches on the garage with its tyre foundation, which will be topped with a green roof. His friend Jean-Nick Trudel comes to lend a hand. Meanwhile, Charles-Antoine embarks on an incredible adventure: tuna fishing in Gaspésie.
The chef welcomes Luca Cianciulli, owner of Moccione and Moccione Pizza. Together, they prepare a grilled flank steak with rosemary, served with lime salsa verde and a potato salad.

Olive oil in pastries, sweet and savoury. Still accompanied by comedian Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet offers a Spanish recipe for sweet anise and sesame biscuits, and a leek quiche. The doughs are made with olive oil. Discovery of the day: Vaud almonds.

Rencontre avec Denis Lesgourgues, producteur d'armagnac ; avec Isabelle et Patrick Collomb, producteurs de légumes bios. Observation de la migration des oiseaux sur l'étang du Moura avec Nicolas Bernadicou. Visite de la Palmeraie du Sarthou avec Daniel Fort. Détour par Elusa, capitale gallo-romaine.

programmes.d: The journey in Gaspésie continues. Will a Bluefin tuna be caught? We follow the path of this majestic fish, from processing in Gaspésie to the plate in Québec City. At the Earthship, the masonry heater begins to take shape.
Soup can be served as a starter or a main dish. To vary the pleasures, Isabelle offers a creamy version with fennel and leftover cooked chicken, and another with spaghetti squash.

Annick Jeanmairet vous propose une chakchouka, sorte de compotée de tomates et de poivrons, avec des oeufs et des herbes, et des aubergines façon tomates farcies. Découverte du jour : l'art du service à table, en compagnie d'un champion qui officie au Domaine de Châteauvieux.

Sébastien Lys pêche le mulet à l'oeil et à l'écoute ; Brice Thomas partage sa passion pour la production de sel. Ramassage d'oeufs de raies avec l'association IODDE. Raphaël Musseau, docteur en écologie, et Jean-Claude Barbraud, ornithologue au Muséum national d'histoire naturelle, suivent les cigognes blanches. Visite de Marans.

programmes.d: In Abercorn, all the projects have been completed, or almost! Meanwhile, a new morel mushroom cultivation project is taking shape... At Montréal Plaza, the tenth anniversary celebration takes place.
Two recipes on the menu: rigatoni with mushrooms and almonds, and pan-seared salmon with ginger and maple sauce.
Premières recettes mitonnées par Annick Jeanmairet, accompagnée de Simon Romang : une couronne des rois et des moules poiré gingembre.

"Hugo Guinet, maraîcher bio et éleveur de poules, vend ses produits directement au consommateur. Tout savoir sur le cavage des truffes avec le trufficulteur Philippe de Santis, qui propose les précieux tubercules au marché d'Aups. La végétation du massif des Maures et la biodiversité sous-marine de la lagune du Brusc."

Christian welcomes actor Marc-André Grondin, writer Chrystine Brouillet, and chef Jean-Michel Leblond to cook foods considered 'unappetizing.' From offal to snails, they explore unusual flavors.
Au menu : tagliatelles fraîches aux orties. Découverte du jour : Notes de fève, une fabrique de chocolat 100 % artisanale.
Isabelle reçoit Ricardo pour réaliser des pancakes à la ricotta, à servir avec des fraises rôties, et elle prépare un granola au chocolat noir gourmand pour le déjeuner.

Rencontre avec Valérie Ratagne au milieu de ses chèvres Saanen et de leurs petits. Tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur la production de plants et de semences paysannes : les explications d'Auriane Bertrand. Solidarité et biodiversité s'expriment grâce à la relance viticole et à l'investissement d'élèves de maternelle.

With commentator Matthieu Proulx, host Isabelle Racicot, actress Marie-Ève Perron, and chef Carolyne Frigon, we prepare super healthy bowls to challenge junk food culture.

"Annick Jeanmairet vous propose en menu des filets de féra sauce rhubarbe, et en dessert des fraises, pop-corn au caramel, mini-meringues. Découverte du jour : du kombucha urbain et artisanal, en plein coeur de Lausanne."

Isabelle faire cuire un steak qu'elle accompagne d'un beurre au miso aromatisé au jalapeño et aux oignons verts ainsi que des pommes de terre écrasées, qu'elle sert sur une mayonnaise mélangée avec du sel et du vinaigre.

"Cap sur la Bretagne en compagnie de Sylvain Huchette, éleveur d'ormeaux et cultivateur d'algues. Maël Kervennal présente sa pépinière d'arbres fruitiers alors que les pommiers sont en fleurs. Mickaël Guillou préserve les marais de Landéda. L'herboriste Florence Créachcadec apprend aux habitants à se familiariser avec les plantes de leur jardin."

The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programmes.d: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.
Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

"Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."
Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programmes.d: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.
The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

"Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."

An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.

The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programmes.d: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.
Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

"Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."
Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programmes.d: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.
The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

"Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.
For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

programmes.d: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

Solidarité et biodiversité s'expriment grâce à la relance viticole et à l'investissement d'élèves de maternelle.

programmes.d: A renowned two-Michelin-starred chef, Bruno Oger, at the head of La Villa Archange in Le Cannet, takes us to discover favorite spots in the Cannes hinterland, from Mougins to the Lérins Islands. A cuisine between Breton and Mediterranean traditions.
From cleaning to ingredient shopping, preparation, and service, Christian follows chef Minh Phat Tu through a day managing his three restaurants.
Celebrating lemons. Accompanied by comedian Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a two-lemon meringue tart. Discovery of the day: Sansho berry. Presentation: Annick Jeanmairet.
The chef prepares a strawberry and cream cake that will delight anyone intolerant to gluten, without sacrificing indulgence.

programmes.d: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.
Au menu : la recette de la cheffe Marie Robert, rencontre avec un chocolatier fan de musique metal, dégustation d'un petit-déjeuner typiquement parisien, le dessert de Christophe Loeffel.

Casoncellis, 100% pork ravioli.Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a recipe for casoncellis, original crescent-shaped ravioli. Discovery of the day: the torrée, a Neuchâtel tradition.
Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

"Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. programmes.d: A Michelin-starred chef at the Rouge restaurant in Nîmes, Georgiana Viou returns to Marseille, where it all began for the chef. The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programmes.t: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programmes.d: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.
Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

"Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."
Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programmes.t: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programmes.d: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programmes.d: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.
The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

"Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."
You have accidently drowned your noodles in soya sauce? Luckily, the three presenters are there to transform this mistake into an excellent accompaniment.
How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programmes.d: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.
For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

"Rencontre avec Nicolas Bucher, éleveur de vache montbéliarde, et avec Nathalie Vernerey, cheffe de culture maraîchère aux Jardins d'idées. programmes.d: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

The chef welcomes Luca Cianciulli, owner of Moccione and Moccione Pizza. Together, they prepare a grilled flank steak with rosemary, served with lime salsa verde and a potato salad.

Raphaël Musseau, docteur en écologie, et Jean-Claude Barbraud, ornithologue au Muséum national d'histoire naturelle, suivent les cigognes blanches. Visite de Marans.

Two recipes on the menu: rigatoni with mushrooms and almonds, and pan-seared salmon with ginger and maple sauce.
Premières recettes mitonnées par Annick Jeanmairet, accompagnée de Simon Romang : une couronne des rois et des moules poiré gingembre.

Solidarité et biodiversité s'expriment grâce à la relance viticole et à l'investissement d'élèves de maternelle.

Isabelle nous invite à profiter de la saison du crabe. Elle élabore des crêpes soufflées aux herbes et au crabe ainsi que des beignets au crabe bien moelleux, accompagnés d'une mayonnaise épicée.

"Direction le Sud de la France, où Émilie et Maxime cultivent les légumes sur sol vivant avant de les cuisiner. À l'occasion de la dernière émission de la saison, Isabelle prépare un gâteau au chocolat et au fruit de la passion, exquis pour toutes les occasions.

Dans le Larzac, à Nant, Marion Renoud-Lias et Romain Debord cultivent des plantes et des fleurs, tout en testant des recettes de gin. A tribute to Canadian Francophonie with guinea fowl breast, roasted cauliflower, mussels, and butter tarts. With chefs Étienne Croteau and John Winter Russell, singer Damien Robitaille, and artist Édith Butler.

programmes.d: A renowned two-Michelin-starred chef, Bruno Oger, at the head of La Villa Archange in Le Cannet, takes us to discover favorite spots in the Cannes hinterland, from Mougins to the Lérins Islands. A cuisine between Breton and Mediterranean traditions.
From cleaning to ingredient shopping, preparation, and service, Christian follows chef Minh Phat Tu through a day managing his three restaurants.
Celebrating lemons. Accompanied by comedian Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a two-lemon meringue tart. Discovery of the day: Sansho berry. Presentation: Annick Jeanmairet.
The chef prepares a strawberry and cream cake that will delight anyone intolerant to gluten, without sacrificing indulgence.

"Dans cette partie de la Bresse située en Saône-et-Loire, Jean-Thomas Vuillard est pisciculteur ; Alexandre Cauchy, producteur de piment et maraîcher. À découvrir en compagnie d'Aurélien Poirel : les espèces de la réserve naturelle nationale de Truchère-Ratenelle. Atelier plumes avec Estelle Petiot, à l'écomusée de la Bresse bourguignonne."

programmes.d: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.
Au menu : la recette de la cheffe Marie Robert, rencontre avec un chocolatier fan de musique metal, dégustation d'un petit-déjeuner typiquement parisien, le dessert de Christophe Loeffel.

Casoncellis, 100% pork ravioli.Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a recipe for casoncellis, original crescent-shaped ravioli. Discovery of the day: the torrée, a Neuchâtel tradition.
Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

"Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programmes.d: A Michelin-starred chef at the Rouge restaurant in Nîmes, Georgiana Viou returns to Marseille, where it all began for the chef. The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programmes.t: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programmes.d: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.
Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

"Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."
Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programmes.t: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programmes.d: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programmes.t: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programmes.d: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.
The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

"Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."
You have accidently drowned your noodles in soya sauce? Luckily, the three presenters are there to transform this mistake into an excellent accompaniment.
How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

"Rencontre avec Nicolas Bucher, éleveur de vache montbéliarde, et avec Nathalie Vernerey, cheffe de culture maraîchère aux Jardins d'idées. Le phytomanagement au Living Lab de Vieux-Charmont, avec Michel Chalot, professeur d'université et biologiste en environnement. « Pas si bêtes », avec Thibaut Seguin, animateur à La Damassine."

Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.
For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

A stage that ends in the Michelin-starred restaurant Don Alfonso 1890, around a dish of scorpion fish pasta.

programmes.d: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

Mushrooms and eggs. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares baked eggs with mushrooms and a spring frittata (Italian egg-based dish), with lots of greens (dandelion, arugula, spinach). Discovery of the day: artisanal mate, a drink that is all the rage.
To entertain simply and stylishly, the chef offers a menu featuring haddock poached in coconut milk and a crunchy salad.

April Fools fish. Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a fish ceviche with leche de tigre, a more complex mixture than lime juice, followed by fish paupiettes wrapped in chard leaves, steamed. Discovery of the day: chard táchon.
Ricardo joins Isabelle to celebrate bread in all its forms: a savory garlic version, perfect for sharing, and a brioche variation with chocolate, cranberries, and ginger.

Isabelle creates a salmon tart inspired by bagels and deconstructs the famous lemon tart into bars.

Long live legumes. On the menu: lentils papet vaudois style and crispy chickpeas for the aperitif. Discovery of the day: Geneva longeole cooked on the plancha. Annick Jeanmairet is once again assisted by comedian Brigitte Rosset.

Valentin Fleytoux et Rodolphe Dieudonné sont producteurs fermiers de cancoillotte ; Camille Ponnelle et Xavier Mariot sont agriculteurs et produisent des huiles. Réhabilitation de la rivière La Linotte avec Guillaume Blondel-Gaborieau, ingénieur et maire de Loulans-Verchamp. The chef welcomes Luca Cianciulli, owner of Moccione and Moccione Pizza. Together, they prepare a grilled flank steak with rosemary, served with lime salsa verde and a potato salad.

Olive oil in pastries, sweet and savoury. Still accompanied by comedian Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet offers a Spanish recipe for sweet anise and sesame biscuits, and a leek quiche. The doughs are made with olive oil. Discovery of the day: Vaud almonds.

Rencontre avec Denis Lesgourgues, producteur d'armagnac ; avec Isabelle et Patrick Collomb, producteurs de légumes bios. Observation de la migration des oiseaux sur l'étang du Moura avec Nicolas Bernadicou. Visite de la Palmeraie du Sarthou avec Daniel Fort. Détour par Elusa, capitale gallo-romaine.

Soup can be served as a starter or a main dish. To vary the pleasures, Isabelle offers a creamy version with fennel and leftover cooked chicken, and another with spaghetti squash.

Annick Jeanmairet vous propose une chakchouka, sorte de compotée de tomates et de poivrons, avec des oeufs et des herbes, et des aubergines façon tomates farcies. Découverte du jour : l'art du service à table, en compagnie d'un champion qui officie au Domaine de Châteauvieux.

Sébastien Lys pêche le mulet à l'oeil et à l'écoute ; Brice Thomas partage sa passion pour la production de sel. Ramassage d'oeufs de raies avec l'association IODDE. Raphaël Musseau, docteur en écologie, et Jean-Claude Barbraud, ornithologue au Muséum national d'histoire naturelle, suivent les cigognes blanches. Visite de Marans.

programmes.d: In Abercorn, all the projects have been completed, or almost! Meanwhile, a new morel mushroom cultivation project is taking shape... At Montréal Plaza, the tenth anniversary celebration takes place.
Two recipes on the menu: rigatoni with mushrooms and almonds, and pan-seared salmon with ginger and maple sauce.
Premières recettes mitonnées par Annick Jeanmairet, accompagnée de Simon Romang : une couronne des rois et des moules poiré gingembre.

"Hugo Guinet, maraîcher bio et éleveur de poules, vend ses produits directement au consommateur. Tout savoir sur le cavage des truffes avec le trufficulteur Philippe de Santis, qui propose les précieux tubercules au marché d'Aups. La végétation du massif des Maures et la biodiversité sous-marine de la lagune du Brusc."

Christian welcomes actor Marc-André Grondin, writer Chrystine Brouillet, and chef Jean-Michel Leblond to cook foods considered 'unappetizing.' From offal to snails, they explore unusual flavors.
Au menu : tagliatelles fraîches aux orties. Découverte du jour : Notes de fève, une fabrique de chocolat 100 % artisanale.
Isabelle reçoit Ricardo pour réaliser des pancakes à la ricotta, à servir avec des fraises rôties, et elle prépare un granola au chocolat noir gourmand pour le déjeuner.
